title: 第199章 灵药董戈第198章 马继章选择洞府
content_zh:
第199章灵药，董戈。
顾景元抬脚走向洞府山体最深处，随着顾景元手掐法诀，一处灵潭出现。
灵潭处于两座山崖的狭缝之间，周围有几座阵法封锁，里面乳白色灵雾缭绕不散。
除此之外，随着夜幕缓缓降临，一丝丝月华被牵引而来，灵潭周围还放置了七八块黑色的晶体，此刻也是释放丝丝缕缕的黑色雾气，和月华结合，然后被灵潭一株莲花吸收。
此莲莲茎并非翠绿，而是呈现一种半透明的幽蓝色，宛若寒冰雕琢，又似凝实的月华，自墨玉般的潭底笔直探出水面。
茎身不见丝毫瑕疵，内里却有无数比发丝更细的银色光丝缓缓脉动，如同活物的经络，将来自潭底的地阴之气与天上月华的精粹，源源不断输送到顶端。
水面之上，五片莲叶舒展。
叶色是深邃的暗紫色，近乎墨黑，叶面光滑，不沾滴水，叶脉却是清晰无比的银白色，在月光下勾勒出繁复玄奥的天然纹路，仿佛一幅微缩的周天星图。
莲叶边缘，有一圈极淡的、几乎难以察觉的银色光边，随着吞吐，流转明灭。
“五叶的月魂莲？”
月魂莲五十年生一叶，最高可达九叶。
五叶，二百五十年。
顾景元观察了一下，这月魂莲种下的时间应该只有一百五十年到两百年，但因为有阵法，加上浓郁的灵气，以及那蕴含魂力的黑色晶体促进了生长，这才达到了五叶的程度。
而月魂莲对筑基修士的神魂有很大滋养效果，也是炼制月魂凝神丹的主药之一。
月魂凝神丹可修复神魂伤势，抵御修炼产生的心魔，凝实神魂。
“好隐蔽的地方，若非我此刻的神魂之力超过一般的筑基后期修士，怕是也很难察觉吧。”
顾景元喃喃，随即又走向另一个方向。
依旧隐蔽，距离洞府中心较远，在一处乱石合围的凹陷地坑之中，一株带着兽形的小草静静立在那边。
此地同样设有防御、隐蔽、锁灵三类阵法封锁。
顾景元手掐法诀，数十息后打开一个口子，神识探入其中。

小草不是重点，在小草之下有一株虎形人参。
通体土黄色，参体表面天然生有复杂的土褐色虎纹，无数触须延伸，吸收土元之力。
而在这人参周围，还埋着两具二阶下品的虎类妖兽尸体。
“这是土属性灵药，地虎玉元参。服用可壮大精元、淬炼体魄，也可炼制多种丹药，辅助土属性功法提升，对筑基后期修士也有不小用处。
看着虎尸的腐烂程度，应该才埋下不到一个月啊。而这地虎玉元参差不多也有两百年的药龄了，种下的时间应该只有一百多年，浓郁灵气和虎尸催发了一些，看来是有人经常打理了。”
说完，又走到洞府中央。
这边有一棵三丈高的灵树，树冠并不广阔，呈伞盖状自然舒展，枝干并非笔直向上，而是带着一种自然的弯曲，如苍龙盘结。
枝叶翠绿欲滴，充满生机，隐约可见其中有十来个青涩的果子，每个果子中都有两道淡青色纹路。
这果树没有任何遮掩，静静地矗立在这里。
五纹灵果树，十年长一纹，五十年成熟一次，可炼制供筑基修士恢复灵气、提升修为的丹药....
content_en:
Chapter 199: Panacea, Dong Ge.
Gu Jingyuan raised his feet and walked towards the deepest part of the Dongfu Mountain. As Gu Jingyuan used his hands to perform the magic formula, a spiritual pool appeared.
The Lingtan is located between the slit of two cliffs, surrounded by several formations to block it, and the milky white spiritual mist lingers inside.
In addition, as night falls slowly, wisps of moonlight are drawn in, and seven or eight black crystals are placed around the Lingtan. At this moment, strands of black mist are also released, combined with the moonlight, and then absorbed by a lotus in the Lingtan.
The stems of this lotus are not emerald green, but appear a translucent blue, as if carved by ice, or like solid moonlight, sticking out of the water from the bottom of the inky jade-like pool.
There is no flaw in the stem body, but inside there are countless silvery strands of light that are thinner than a hair, pulsing slowly, like the meridians of living creatures, continuously transporting the essence of the earthly yin energy from the bottom of the pool and the moonlight in the sky to the top.
Above the water, five lotus leaves stretch.
The leaf color is a deep dark purple, almost ink black. The leaf surface is smooth and does not drip water, but the leaf veins are extremely clear and silvery white. Under the moonlight, complex and mysterious natural lines are outlined, like a miniature star map of the sky.
On the edge of the lotus leaf, there is a very faint, almost imperceptible silver edge, which flickers and fades with the inhalation.
"Five-leaf Moon Soul Lotus?"
Moon Soul Lotus produces one leaf every fifty years, and can have up to nine leaves.
Five leaves, two hundred and fifty years.
Gu Jingyuan observed that the Moon Soul Lotus was only planted for 150 to 200 years, but because of the formation, the rich spiritual energy, and the black crystals containing soul power that promoted the growth, it has only reached the level of five leaves.
The Moon Soul Lotus has a great nourishing effect on the soul of the foundation-building monks, and is also one of the main medicines for refining the Moon Soul Condensation Pill.
The Moon Soul Condensation Pill can repair the injuries of the soul, resist the inner demons caused by practice, and solidify the soul.
"It's such a hidden place. If my soul power at the moment wasn't stronger than that of an ordinary late-stage foundation-building monk, it would probably be difficult to detect it."
Gu Jingyuan murmured, then walked in another direction.
Still hidden, far away from the center of the cave, in a sunken pit surrounded by rocks, a small grass with an animal shape stood quietly there.
This place also has three types of formation blockades: defense, concealment, and soul locking.
Gu Jingyuan used his hand to make a secret. After a few dozen breaths, he opened a hole and penetrated it with his spiritual consciousness.
The grass is not the point. There is a tiger-shaped ginseng under the grass.
The whole body is earthy yellow, with complex earthy brown tiger stripes naturally appearing on the surface of the ginseng body. Countless tentacles extend to absorb the power of earth element.
And around the ginseng, there were two corpses of second-level low-grade tiger monsters buried.
"This is an earth-attribute elixir, Earth Tiger Jade Yuanshen. Taking it can strengthen the essence and temper the body. It can also be used to refine a variety of elixirs to assist in the improvement of earth-attribute skills. It is also of great use to monks in the later stages of foundation building.
Judging from the degree of decomposition of the tiger carcass, it must have been buried for less than a month. The Earth Tiger Jade Ginseng is almost two hundred years old, and it should have only been planted for more than a hundred years. The rich spiritual energy and tiger corpses have stimulated it, so it seems that someone has been taking care of it regularly. "
After saying that, he walked to the center of the cave again.
There is a three-foot-tall spiritual tree here. The crown of the tree is not broad, but stretches naturally in the shape of an umbrella. The branches are not straight upward, but have a natural bend, like a coiled dragon.
The branches and leaves are emerald green and full of vitality. There are a dozen green fruits vaguely visible, each with two light cyan lines.
This fruit tree stands here quietly without any cover.
The five-line spiritual fruit tree grows once every ten years and matures once every fifty years. It can be used to refine elixirs for foundation-building monks to restore their aura and improve their cultivation...
